# `levenshtein`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the Levenshtein distance between the two given strings. If threshold is set and distance more than it, return -1.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
levenshtein(str1, str2[, threshold])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- levenshtein, example 1
> SELECT levenshtein('kitten', 'sitting');
3
```

```sql
-- levenshtein, example 2
> SELECT levenshtein('kitten', 'sitting', 2);
-1
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
